summary: Listed as a lookout in Haralson County, Georgia, with GFC number 719; no source found describes its history or whether it still stands.

evidence.supports: Tower list: Buchanan in Haralson County, coordinates 33.77899,-85.16767, GFC number 719
The page's More info list describes the tower list as covering lat/lon, elevation and GFC number
evidence.quote: GA tower list lat/lon, elevation, GFC number

evidence.supports: The same page links to the Georgia Forestry Commission
Page carries a Google map revision stamp dated 22 March 2016
Forest Lookouts Georgia index names Buchanan, Haralson County, and gives nothing more
Wikipedia: Buchanan is a city and the county seat of Haralson County
evidence.quote: Buchanan is a city and the county seat of Haralson County

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only two lists name this lookout (the tnlandforms Georgia tower list and the Forest Lookouts Georgia index). A Haralson County Historical Society Buchanan timeline was read and has no tower entry. No register, dated, descriptive or newspaper source was found, so build date, design, staffing, status and access are unknown. The story is about 110 words of body text with no history beyond the lists; hold for archival work (Georgia Forestry Commission records, Haralson County newspapers and historical society archives) before extending. Not reached: gfc.state.ga.us history page (timed out). Two web searches gave nothing tower-specific. The list's elevation column (1426) has no stated unit and is not used. Wikipedia is cited only for the city and its county seat status. Nothing was attempted on site access.
